name: kindred-mcp
description: MCP servers for Kindred-Asterling infrastructure: Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Fly.io, and Hello.coop app admin.

database_uri.title: PostgreSQL connection URI
database_uri.description: postgresql:// URI for the database the Postgres MCP server connects to (e.g. Fly staging). Stored in secure storage, never in settings.json.

postgres_access_mode.title: PostgreSQL access mode
postgres_access_mode.description: restricted = read-only queries; unrestricted = full read/write. Keep restricted for staging and production.
